total_scope_note: Comparison-only run; no candidate is selected, so overall totals exclude all alternatives.
optimization_notes: Candidate prices are comparisons only and do not represent committed architecture pricing.
Monthly equivalents for daily SQL DTU meters use 365/12 days per average month. Hourly meters use 730 hours per month.
Delta is the spread among fully priced candidates only; it is null for any decision set with an unresolved candidate.
savings_reason: No reservation meter was returned for P1v3; savings cannot be quantified.

sql-prod/GP-serverless-Gen5/General Purpose storage: both paid and Free data-stored meters were returned without a tier or allowance boundary that establishes which applies to 32 GB.
sql-prod/GP-serverless-Gen5/LRS backup storage: the LRS meter is priced per GB/month, but no backup GB-month quantity was supplied.
app-plan-prod-zr/P1v3-PAYG-2-instances: no matching P1v3 PAYG price was returned by MCP or the direct fallback.

retail_api_attempts.calculation: No matching meter returned; no cost calculated.
